hero.eyebrow: LC Studio · The creator app · Invitation-only
hero.title: Build your official AI clone, right from your phone.
hero.lead: Create and manage an official AI clone from your own voice and words. Then look after its chats, calls, morning calls and LIVE shows from one app.
hero.audience: For creators, talent, voice actors, athletes, singers, and their agencies.
hero.note: LC Studio is invitation-only. An invite code is required to open your studio.
hero.disclosure: Every creator profile on LinClone is shown to followers as an AI clone.
hero.fanLink: Want to talk with your favorites? Get the LinClone app
hero.phoneAlt: Illustration of a clone being created in LC Studio. When the ring fills, it’s ready.

statement.fill: The you that never goes offline.
statement.sub: Chats in your words. Calls, morning calls and LIVE shows in your voice.

home.fill: Chats, LIVE and earnings. All from your phone.
home.lead: LC Studio’s Home holds everything you need to run your clone. Tap a tile to jump to how it works.

tiles.fanContent: Images and voices followers made with your clone
tiles.homeVoice: Voice messages followers hear on Home

home.stageAlt: Illustration of LC Studio’s Home: your clone’s status and its feature tiles.

setup.title: Set up your clone, right from your phone.
setup.lead: Pick how you talk, write in your own words, add official photos and your voice. Don’t aim for perfect; you can change everything later.
setup.trust: Anything we read from your Wikipedia or YouTube links, or from files you upload, comes back as a suggestion. You decide what your clone keeps.

picks.title: Who you are
picks.body: Tap to pick how you refer to yourself, your dialect and your hobbies.

words.title: In your own words
words.body: Write freely: stories, catchphrases, what you’re up to.

photos.title: Official photos
photos.body: Choose the photos followers will see.

modes.title: Relationship modes
modes.body: Choose the ways followers can have you talk.

ng.title: NG topics
ng.body: Decide up front what your clone should never get into.

voice.title: Your voice
voice.body: Record in the app or upload files. The best material is you, talking naturally with someone.

setup.readyBody: Voice cloning and personality tuning usually take a few minutes.
setup.stageAlt: Illustrations of clone setup in LC Studio.

check.title: Talk to it before your followers do.
check.lead: Chat, voice-call and try a morning call in preview mode. Nothing here is shown to followers or counted in analytics.
check.fill: Exactly what your followers will hear.
check.stageAlt: Illustration of a creator on a preview call with their own AI clone.

control.fill: You always have the final say.
control.lead: Grow facts, your profile, topics you’d rather avoid. You always decide.

grow.title: Grow is approval-based
grow.body: Approve or reject every fact followers propose, and reverse any decision later.

ng.title: NG topics
ng.body: Topics you switch on get top priority across chat, calls, Stories and LIVE, and your clone is set to steer clear of them.

profile.title: Your profile, your likeness
profile.body: Edit or hide anything on your public profile. You can turn off AI images of you made by followers.

labels.title: Clearly labeled as AI
labels.body: Every image shared outside LinClone carries an “AI-generated / not the real person” label.

real.title: Step in as the real you.
real.officialBody: Join any follower’s chat with an official reply. Official replies carry a verified badge and are shown apart from AI replies.
real.pauseBody: You can also pause your clone’s replies in a single chat.
real.liveTitle: Your clone hosts the LIVE show.
real.liveBody: Your clone runs the show and reads comments aloud to answer them. You decide whether to accept follower requests. Archives save automatically and can be downloaded.
real.dropIn: You can also drop into the show as yourself.

voice.title: Your voice, in your followers’ every day.
voice.lead: Voice messages on Home, morning-call first lines, even the little “hmm”s in a call. All in your clone’s voice.

lines.l5: Want to listen to the rain with me?

homeVoice.title: Voice messages
homeVoice.body: AI drafts them from your clone’s settings and the latest Grow facts. Your first one publishes automatically; after that, only what you confirm goes out.

morning.title: Morning-call first lines
morning.body: Edit them per tone. Saving re-synthesizes them in your voice.

fillers.title: Fillers
fillers.body: The sounds that cover the moment your clone is thinking. Choose gentle or casual.

insights.title: Know your community.
insights.analyticsBody: See chats, images, voices, call time, coins received and LIVE shows charted over time.
insights.privacy: Individual follower data is shown inside LC Studio only and is never made public in the LinClone app.
insights.earningsBody: Each month’s earnings are finalized from the coins followers spend on your clone. No figures are shown while a month is being calculated. Statements come as CSV, and payouts go to your registered bank account. We’ll explain the details when we’re in touch.

what.a: The creator app for building your official AI clone and running its chats, calls, morning calls, LIVE shows, Grow and earnings from one place.

who.a: It’s invitation-only for now, for creators, talent, voice actors, athletes, singers and their agencies, with an invite code.

cost.a: We’ll go over costs and terms individually when we’re in touch.

studio.q: Do I need a recording studio?
studio.a: No. Setup happens on your phone, and you can record your voice in the app or upload files.

time.a: Voice cloning and personality tuning usually take a few minutes. The screen updates by itself.

control.q: Can I control what my clone says?
control.a: Set NG topics, approve or reject Grow facts, and check everything in preview mode. NG topics get top priority, so your clone is set to steer clear of them.

label.a: Yes. Every creator profile on LinClone is shown as an AI clone, and images shared outside LinClone carry an “AI-generated / not the real person” label.

agency.q: Can my agency team share access?
agency.a: Right now, each account is operated by one person. Agencies are welcome to contact us by email.

stop.q: What if I want to stop?
stop.a: Delete your account in the app. Your clone is unpublished immediately, and your voice data and AI voice models are permanently deleted within a set period. See the Privacy Policy for details.

legacy.q: I already have a clone on LinClone.
legacy.a: You can build a draft from your existing LinClone character and personality analysis, and keep your current voice.

release.q: When will it be on the stores?
release.a: We’re preparing the store release. If you request an invitation, we’ll tell you how to get the app when we’re in touch.

releaseLive.a: On the App Store and Google Play. An invite code is required to open your studio.

final.title: Go meet the other you.
final.sub: Start by requesting an invitation. We’ll be in touch.
